test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is an Indian Singer of Hindustani Classical Music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shubha Mudgal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shubha Mudgal** is a famous Indian singer of 'Hindustani classical music.
 
• Her repertoire includes the genres of **Khyal, thumri, Dadra, and Indian pop.**
 
• **She has received Padma Shri in 2000.**
 
• Shubha grew up in Allahabad and after finishing school, attended St. Mary's Convent Inter College. As children, she and her sister were sent by their artistic-minded parents to a dance class to learn kathak.

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/21/Shubha_Mudgal_%281%29.JPG/300px-Shubha_Mudgal_%281%29.JPG] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sripathi Panditaradhyula Balasubrahmanyam** also known as SPB or Balu, was an Indian playback singer, television presenter, music director, actor and film producer who worked predominantly in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Hindi and Malayalam films.​ 
 
• **Pandit Kishan Maharaj** was an Indian tabla player who belonged to the Benares Gharana of Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Dwaram Venkataswamy Naidu **was one of the most important Carnatic music violinists of the 20th century.
